title: Role of the Immune System in Preventing Laryngeal Cancer
official: Laryngeal Dysplasia and Progression to Carcinoma: Investigating Genetic and Immune Alterations Predictive of Malignant Transformation
summary: Laryngeal dysplasia and progression to carcinoma: investigating genetic and immune alterations predictive of malignant transformation
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Histopathological diagnosis of laryngeal dysplasia.
* Age \>18 years and informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Prior surgical, radiotherapeutic, or oncologic treatments for head and neck regions.
* Congenital or acquired immunodeficiency disorders.
* Synchronous malignancies.
* Immunosuppressive therapy.
* Age \<18 years or absence of research consent.
